# SUPPORT.md — getting help in the palace

## Maintainer contact

- **General questions**: [Q&A Discussions](https://github.com/chrisalunlloyd2-sudo/mindpalace/discussions/categories/q-a) — public, searchable, fastest for how-to questions
- **Concept feedback / ideas**: [Discussion #21](https://github.com/chrisalunlloyd2-sudo/mindpalace/discussions/21) (Ideas)
- **Private/sensitive (conduct, security)**: [GitHub profile contact](https://github.com/chrisalunlloyd2-sudo) → "Start a conversation" (relays email without exposing addresses); direct email available on request
- **Security reports**: open a `question`-labeled issue with *no reproduction details*; we'll move to private coordination

## Where different problems go

| Problem | Where |
|---------|-------|
| Game bug | [bug template](ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.md) |
| Feature idea | [feature template](ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature_request.md) |
| Docs wrong/stale | [docs template](ISSUE_TEMPLATE/docs_issue.md) |
| Program steps/evidence | the [step-log #9](https://github.com/chrisalunlloyd2-sudo/mindpalace/issues/9) (append-only, automated) |
| Concept feedback | [Discussion #21](https://github.com/chrisalunlloyd2-sudo/mindpalace/discussions/21) |
| Conduct report | CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md → maintainer contact above |

## Response expectations

- Labeled issues triaged within a week (CONTRIBUTION_NORMS.md commitment)
- Discussions answered on best effort — the maintainer is one person
  plus an autonomous program that ships, not a support desk
- Security reports: acknowledged within 48h, private fix before public note
